general_information.title: Medication-Induced Arrhythmias
general_information.details: Treatment of life-threatening arrhythmias, including use of digoxin and various antiarrhythmic drugs, and the study of drug-induced torsades de pointes.

general_information.title: Adult Congenital Heart Disease
general_information.details: Discusses interactions in tetralogy of Fallot and the role of genetic information in clinical outcomes. The use of devices like implantable cardioverter defibrillators in managing congenital conditions.
